_comment: forest_tree_prop_c: the leaner: a ~1.15 m trunk leaning ~16 deg, forking at 3.6 m into two crowned limbs. A loose prop for map 3's lane, placed by hand as cover on the path; origin at the foot of the trunk on the ground plane so it drops onto the lane at identity. One material (the forest atlas, shared with forest_build.py), one contiguous mesh. ForestTreePropCCollision is the purpose-built collider shipped as a `-colonly` node -- the trunk's own silhouette, not a box, so a runner behind the trunk is behind the collider at every height a runner can occupy; the crown does not collide. Godot turns it into a StaticBody3D + ConcavePolygonShape3D and drops its mesh, so `surfaces` counts only what is drawn.
